_help: Maps Rocksmith tones to your presets. Checked in this order, first match wins:
1. songs: per arrangement and slot, e.g. {"skid18an_lead": {"C": "Distortion"}} (slots: Base, A, B, C, D)
2. tones: per tone key (see tone_catalog.csv), e.g. {"skid18an_dist": "Crunch"}
3. rules: the first rule whose conditions all hold: 'all' tags, 'amp' (the tone's amp), 'gain' (amp gain knob at least),
and, if given, one of its 'any' tags or 'name' words
Then artists can change the result of 3 or 4 for a whole band, e.g. {"Bon Jovi": {"Heavy": "Crunch"}}.
rstone re-reads this file while running, so edits apply on the next tone change.
The companion app switches between four categories (Clean, Crunch, Heavy, Lead; MIDI Program Change 0-3).
Its overrides use those names; 'categories' says which category every other preset name means.
Song-made tones (Stagehand): 'rigs' picks the rig a song's tones start from by the song's heaviness
(0-1, see songs.csv), the last whose 'from' it reaches; 'song_rigs' names one for a song key or an artist,
